subtasks.title: Write tests verifying subtask scheduling extraction
subtasks.description:
Write a test file `subtask_scheduling_test.go` that verifies the three extracted functions (`scheduleSubtasks`, `dispatchPendingSubtasks`, `orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority`) are callable and behave correctly when invoked from the new file location.

Tests to write:
1. `TestScheduleSubtasks_NoSubtasks` — calls `scheduleSubtasks` on a parent with no backlog subtasks, asserts nil error and no state changes. Uses `testutil.NewTestDB` for DB setup and `testutil.CreateProject`/`testutil.CreateTask` for test data.
2. `TestDispatchPendingSubtasks_NoBacklogSubtasks` — calls `dispatchPendingSubtasks` on an orchestrator with no backlog subtasks, asserts no panics/errors.
3. `TestOrderCandidatesByExperimentPriority_NilScheduler` — calls `orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority` with `experimentScheduler == nil`, asserts candidates returned unchanged.

These tests will initially pass (functions exist in task_processing.go) but serve as regression guards after the move. The key acceptance criterion (file line count) is verified by the integration subtask.

The Orchestrator struct is defined in `orchestrator.go` with fields: `db`, `projectID`, `runner`, `worktree`, `logger`, `experimentScheduler`, etc. Create test orchestrators using `&Orchestrator{db: db, projectID: project.ID, logger: slog.Default()}` pattern — see existing tests in `scheduling_test.go` for the pattern.

IMPORTANT: Use `testutil.NewTestDB()` for database creation. Use `testutil.CreateProject()` and `testutil.CreateTask()` for test entity creation. Do NOT define local helper functions.

subtasks.title: Extract subtask scheduling functions to new file
subtasks.description:
Move three functions from `task_processing.go` to a new file `subtask_scheduling.go` in the same package (`orchestrator`).

Functions to extract (cut from task_processing.go, paste into subtask_scheduling.go):
1. `scheduleSubtasks` — lines 266-544 (including the doc comment starting at line 266)
2. `dispatchPendingSubtasks` — lines 706-747 (including doc comment at line 706)
3. `orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority` — lines 749-810 (including doc comment at line 749)

The new file `subtask_scheduling.go` needs:
- `package orchestrator` declaration
- Imports: `fmt`, `log/slog`, `sort`, `strings`, `github.com/google/uuid`, and internal packages `model`, `prompt`, `state`
- All three functions pasted in order

After extraction, `task_processing.go` retains: `processBacklog`, `processPlanning`, `findCurrentGroup`, `checkFeatureCompletion`, `handlePaused`. Its import block should be trimmed — remove `sort` (only used by `orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority`) and `prompt` (only used by `scheduleSubtasks`). Keep `fmt`, `log/slog`, `strings`, `uuid`, `model`, `state`, `worktree`.

Verification: `wc -l task_processing.go` must be <= 800. `go vet ./internal/orchestrator/... && go test ./internal/orchestrator/...` must pass.

Do NOT modify any function bodies. Do NOT rename anything. This is a pure file-level move.

subtasks.title: Integration: verify extraction and all tests pass
subtasks.description:
Final verification that the extraction is correct and meets all acceptance criteria.

1. Run `wc -l internal/orchestrator/task_processing.go` — must be <= 800 lines
2. Run `wc -l internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go` — must be <= 800 lines
3. Run `gofmt -l internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go internal/orchestrator/task_processing.go` — must produce no output
4. Run `go vet ./internal/orchestrator/...` — must pass
5. Run `go test ./internal/orchestrator/...` — must pass (all existing tests + new tests)
6. Verify no new internal imports added: `grep -r '"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/' internal/orchestrator/subtask_scheduling.go | sort -u | wc -l` should be <= 3 (model, prompt, state)

If any check fails, fix the issue. The integration subtask should NOT need to modify function bodies — only fix import issues or formatting if the extraction introduced any.

This is a simple extraction with no new wiring needed. The functions are same-package methods on *Orchestrator, so all callers (orchestrator.go, test files) continue to work unchanged.

assumptions.decision: Extract all three functions (scheduleSubtasks, dispatchPendingSubtasks, orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority) together rather than just the minimum needed to get under 800
alternatives: Extract only dispatchPendingSubtasks + orderCandidatesByExperimentPriority (~104 lines, minimum to get under 800)
assumptions.why_chosen: Task description explicitly names all three functions. They form a coherent group (subtask scheduling logic). Extracting all three creates a focused file and leaves task_processing.go with only task lifecycle functions (backlog, planning, completion, pausing).

assumptions.decision: Do not extract findCurrentGroup (lines 550-573) even though it is scheduling-related
assumptions.why_chosen: Task description does not mention findCurrentGroup. It is used by the scheduling policy but is not directly part of the subtask dispatch pipeline. Keeping scope minimal reduces risk.
Task description specifies subtask_scheduling.go as the target file name.

This is an internal structural refactor with no user-facing behavior change. The Package Map in ARCHITECTURE.md already describes orchestrator file purposes; the new file will be self-documenting via its function doc comments.
